## Summary of Changes
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue.

- What feature, bugfix, or parity rule was implemented?
- Which IDEs / providers were tested?

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (e.g. new model parity mapping, new IDE hook)
- [ ] Performance / Token optimization
- [ ] Documentation / Community standards

## Testing & Verification
- [ ] Automated unit tests pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`)
- [ ] Tested locally via proxy on `localhost:8080`
- [ ] Tested on interactive dashboard on `localhost:8085`

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows PEP 8 style guidelines.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `README.md`.
- [ ] No private credentials or personal API keys are included.
